lgn.text: Kuberr, a god worshipped by the First, is to be reborn when Akroma learns that Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god, and she declares war on the Cabal.
Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and Braids recovers her sanity and summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch, so Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal.
Kuberr and Akroma's armies then fight at Sanctum, which has become a twisted reflection of itself.
